title: ORIGYN Foundation Funded
description: The ORIGYN Foundation was established in Neuchâtel, Switzerland to begin development of the ORIGYN Protocol.

title: OGY Token Launch
description: The native utility token $OGY is created to power protocol fees, governance, and staking.

title: ORIGYN NFT Standard v1.0
description: Launch of the first version of ORIGYN's NFT standard enabling on-chain certification.

title: Tokenomics 2.0 Update
description: 200 million $OGY tokens previously allocated to the Foundation are burned, initiating deflationary pressure.

title: Minting Platform 1.0
description: Launch of the first on-chain minting interface for digital certificates.

title: Strategic Partnerships
description: Strategic collaborations with FederItaly and METALOR to certify Italian-made products and tokenized gold.

title: First Gold Purchase
description: 3 kg of physical gold bought and tokenized using the ORIGYN Protocol.

title: Acquisition of CanDB
description: ORIGYN acquires CanDB, a decentralized, scalable database solution optimized for NFT metadata.

title: Tokenomics 3.0 and Dashboard Launch
description: A deflationary model is introduced with Tokenomics 3.0 and the first version of the ORIGYN Dashboard is released.

title: 10,000 Protocol Users
description: ORIGYN surpasses 10,000 unique protocol users.

title: Launch of Gold DAO
description: Gold DAO becomes the first DAO built on ORIGYN to tokenize and certify physical gold on-chain.

title: 500M OGY Donation to Gold DAO
description: Half a billion $OGY tokens are donated to support Gold DAO's long-term treasury.

title: ORIGYN DAO Integrated with ICP SNS
description: The ORIGYN DAO becomes fully decentralized and governed on the Internet Computer's SNS framework.

title: Dashboard V2 Release
description: New version of the dashboard includes live metrics, staking stats, and governance tools.

title: 30,000 Users Milestone
description: ORIGYN grows to over 30,000 users, a 300% increase in six months.

title: Collaboration with Leo Caillard and Gil Sertissage
description: ORIGYN certifies physical artworks and diamonds in high-profile partnerships.

title: ORIGYN NFT Standard v2.0
description: NFT standard is upgraded to enable secure certificate transferability.

title: Integrator Framework Launched
description: Rules and onboarding structure created to guide new partners integrating with ORIGYN.

title: Launch of Cecil DAO
description: ORIGYN supports the launch of Cecil DAO to fund conservation and humanitarian projects using blockchain transparency.

title: Acquisition of ClaimLink
description: ORIGYN acquires ClaimLink, a decentralized NFT and token distribution platform built on ICP.

title: ICRC–7 NFT Standard
description: A new standard is introduced to increase certificate interoperability and ecosystem-wide utility.

title: Launch of a Public
description: A self-service tool is launched allowing anyone to mint on-chain, certificates of RWA on ORIGYN infrastructure.
The Runestone mystery will be revealed Q2 2026 in Geneva.

title: Minting Lab
description: A self-service tool is launched allowing anyone to mint on-chain, using ORIGYN infrastructure.

title: IP Protection Implementation
description: Support for on-chain certification of intellectual property rights is integrated into the protocol.

title: Cross–Chain Implementation
description: Cross-chain compatibility expands ORIGYN's reach to other major ecosystems.

title: Global Wallet and Marketplace Integration
description: ORIGYN NFTs become accessible through leading wallets and NFT marketplaces worldwide.

title: Becoming the Universal Certification Standard
description: ORIGYN aims to establish itself as the global benchmark for digital certification across all asset classes.
